name: patient_has_diagnosis_of_cerebrovascular_accident_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has a clinical diagnosis of cerebrovascular accident (stroke).
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has a clinical diagnosis of cerebrovascular accident (stroke).
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have a clinical diagnosis of cerebrovascular accident (stroke).
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has a clinical diagnosis of cerebrovascular accident (stroke).

name: patient_has_diagnosis_of_cerebrovascular_accident_now@@diagnosis_by_radiological_imaging
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient's diagnosis of cerebrovascular accident (stroke) is established by radiological imaging (functional MRI and/or CT).
when_true: Set to true if the patient's diagnosis of cerebrovascular accident (stroke) is established by radiological imaging (functional MRI and/or CT).
when_false: Set to false if the patient's diagnosis of cerebrovascular accident (stroke) is not established by radiological imaging (functional MRI and/or CT).
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the diagnosis of cerebrovascular accident (stroke) is established by radiological imaging.

name: patient_cerebrovascular_accident_time_elapsed_inthehistory_withunit_months
meaning: Numeric value representing the number of months since the patient's most recent cerebrovascular accident (stroke).
when_unknown: Set to null if the time elapsed since the most recent cerebrovascular accident (stroke) is unknown or cannot be determined.
when_value: Set to the number of months since the patient's most recent cerebrovascular accident (stroke), if known.
